description: Generates a hold or sustain envelope stage at the voltage it samples from IN

params.text: Sets how long a hold stage lasts, within the range chosen by the 1/10/100 switch; a sustain stage ignores it
Sets the range of the DURATION knob: 1ms to 1 second, 10ms to 10 seconds, or 100ms to 100 seconds, with the knob centred giving a tenth of the maximum
Chooses what the stage does: HOLD keeps the sampled voltage for the set duration, SUSTAIN keeps it until the GATE falls

inputs.text: While this gate is high the IN signal passes straight to OUT, incoming gates are ignored, and any stage in progress is abandoned; it reads high above 1V
Modulates the duration; every 1V here turns the DURATION knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
The voltage a stage holds, sampled when the stage starts, and passed straight to OUT while DEFER is high
Triggers a hold stage, or holds a sustain stage up for as long as it stays high; it is ignored while DEFER is high, and it reads high above 1V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while a stage is being generated or while DEFER is high, and 0V otherwise
Carries the held voltage, or the IN voltage while DEFER is high
Carries a 1ms 10V pulse when a stage completes

notes: a stage runs only when the GATE input rises; until the first one arrives OUT passes the IN voltage straight through, which is 0V with nothing patched
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
